text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
When I close my eyes reeeal tight, I can
still picture it. The freez'n air
and the soft
scent of snow, fall'n from the sky like a
shower of
powdered sugar.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y'see, I'm from an itsy-bitsy village deep in
the mount'ns, and the
townsfolk've been
cheer'n me on since I first started runn'n.

text_block_list.name: Club Coach
text_block_list.text:
My goodness! You just broke another
record, Yukino! I knew
it—You've got what
it takes to make it big in the city, just like
Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Club Manager
text_block_list.text:
Man... If only we'd sent you to that private
elementary school in
Tokyo! A lot of those
girls go straight onto Tracen!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
N-now, now... There's no use cry'n over
spilt milk. I was nowhere near
ready t'go to
Tokyo yet.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
B'sides... I'm sure I'd be homesick if I left...
And the thought of liv'n
on my own gives
me the heebie-jeebies... Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Club Coach
text_block_list.text:
Well, I suppose you've got a point...
You're still in elementary school,
after all. I
just want to give you all the opportunities I
can to succeed.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: A-and I 'preciate it! I really do! I'd cert'nly love to go someday, just not now. Maybe in middle school... I can picture it now...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Me, liv'n it up surrounded by the glitz 'n'
glam of the big city! I'll run
in those
Twinkly Series races, and then... And
then...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, what'll I do... after that?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I'm home...

Welcome back, Yuki! Did you have a good
practice?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Mifuyu! I didn't know you were here!
Thanks for stopp'n by. Did your
skat'n
practice go well?

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
You betcha! I just had the afternoon off.
Even a figure skater's gotta
rest, you
know?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Mifuyu's a neighbor of mine and one of
my closest friends since I was
a rug rat.
We're practically joined at the hip!)

text_block_list.name: Young Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Guess what I found out, Mifuyu! My mom
says you 'n' I were born on
the same day!

text_block_list.name: Young Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I know, isn't that amaz'n?! And you know
what? I started skat'n around
the same
time you started runn'n!

text_block_list.name: Young Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Gee will'kers! Then... do you think our
dreams will come true at the
same time
too? We'll both become bright, shin'n
stars!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Remember? We used to talk 'bout that all
the time! Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You bet I do! I'm the racer, 'n' you're the
skater! That's what we always
said. After
all, you've been the best ice skater 'round
ever since we
were little.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Well... there are actually a lot of skaters
that are better'n me. I still
haven't placed
in any of the tournaments I join, but that
just means I
have to work harder!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, how was practice for you? I bet
you broke 'nother record
again, didn't
you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... You're right on the money there.
I'm gett'n faster ev'ry day...
but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...H-hey! C-could I... talk to you 'bout
someth'n?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...And that got me think'n... what if I'm just
being a trend chaser? I've
always dreamed
of going to the city, but for what...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
C-come on, Yuki... You're way more than
that! A trend chaser couldn't
run the way
you do!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
You've always dreamed of rac'n in Tokyo,
and those skills of yours
show how hard
you've worked to make that happen... I've
seen't all
with my own eyes, so believe me,
I know!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But what'm I aim'n for? What does the glitz 'n' glam of the city even mean?

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Glitz and glam, huh... Oh! Here, feast your
eyes on this!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Uh... A fash'n magazine?

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Yup! It's chock-full of fashionistas from the
big city! This issue's about
the
Umamusume race stars!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Golly, what a knockout!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Got that right! It's not just her looks,
either! Says here, "This city girl's
a star on
both the track and the runway!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: So this's what a real city girl is like... She's so cute, but more'n that... she's... cool!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
"Q. You caused quite a stir when you
competed in a race right after
modeling in
a big fashion show. What led you to that
decision?"

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
"A. I just want to give both racing and
fashion my all. I know some
people were
worried it'd affect my race, but hey, I won,
didn't I?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Golly... She doesn't give a darn 'bout what
others think... She must
really believe in
herself!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Right! Which got me think'n... maybe this
is the glitz and glam you're
look'n for!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(She's right! My dream... is t'be like this
city girl!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Work'n hard, winn'n races, and doing
everyth'n I can t'be the best
Umamusume I
can be! Up till now, I've been liv'n the slow
life, but
now...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's it... This is what I've always wanted...
I wanna shine, just like
this city girl!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
And I know you can! So what're you
waiting for?! Once you get to
Tokyo,
there'll be a whole new world in front of
you!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
And don't worry, you won't be the only
one explor'n the world... I'm
gonna attend
a train'n camp overseas.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What?! Overseas?! But you're already so good...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Well... like I said, I've never placed in
competitions b'fore. Coach was
say'n my
gold-medal dreams might need to stay a
dream... I'm just not
good enough.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
But I'm gonna make my dreams come true!
That's why I have to seize
any
opportunities given to me, includ'n this
camp!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Golly, you're right... Yeah, we can't just sit
still out here'n the boonies
and expect
opp'rtunities t'come to us...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Now you've got my heart a-rac'n... I... I don't just want my dreams t'come true... I wanna make 'em come true!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks oodles, Mifuyu! You really set me straight... Now I know exactly what I gotta do!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm head'n to the big city... and I'll be the
brightest city girl you've
ever seen!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
With that, I ran off t'convince my parents.
In no time at all, I was say'n
a tearful
goodbye to my village and head'n to
Tokyo.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The city of Tokyo—a sprawling metropolis
where all sorts of
encounters occur, good
and bad...

Tracen Academy Underpriv'leged Ponies
Fund?

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text:
That's right! We're, uh... an associate of
Tracen Academy! Our job is
to collect
money for the poor Umamusume lacking
the funds to attend
school!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reports of fraudulent groups misusing the
Tracen Academy name
have been on the
rise lately... but this Umamusume might not
know
that!

Wowzers... Tracen sure is look'n out for
folks 'round here. I don't have
much cash
m'self, but I can spare a little change! Let's
see...
Jinkies!
